usageNotes: Retrieves operating system information (distro, name, version, kernel, machine type) from a running VM via the QEMU Guest Agent. The Guest Agent must be installed and running inside the VM; if it is not, the call will return an error rather than an empty result. Requires either VM.GuestAgent.Audit or VM.GuestAgent.Unrestricted on the VM's path.

examples.summary: Get OS info from a Linux VM on node pve1

tips: If the Guest Agent is not running, the API returns a 500-class error with a message like 'guest agent is not running'; check agent status with get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_agent_info first.
The response is wrapped in a `result` object; actual OS fields (name, version, id, pretty-name, kernel-release, machine) are nested inside it.
Useful for automated inventory and asset classification — pair with get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_agent_get_host_name to build a complete identity record.
VM must be in a running (started) state; suspended or stopped VMs will not have an active Guest Agent channel.
